controles.affirmation: Dette nette passee de 3 678 M CHF (dec. 2025) a 4 604 M CHF (juin 2026), ratio dette nette/EBITDA de 2,1x a 2,8x en six mois
controles.verbatim_source: Net debt at June 2026 was CHF 4,604 million, up from CHF 3,678 million at the end of December 2025 and compared to CHF 4,490 million at June 2025. The net debt to EBITDA ratio was 2.8 in June 2026, compared to 2.5 in June 2025 and 2.1 at the end of December 2025.

controles.affirmation: Flux de tresorerie disponible ajuste negatif a -119 M CHF (-3,1% du CA) contre -16 M CHF (-0,4%) ; besoin en fonds de roulement a 30,8% des ventes contre 27,1%
controles.verbatim_source: Adjusted Free Cash Flow was CHF -119 million in the first half of 2026, versus CHF -16 million for the comparable period in 2025. As a percentage of sales, Adjusted Free Cash Flow in the first six months of 2026 was -3.1%, compared to -0.4% in 2025 ; Net working capital was 30.8% of sales in June 2026 compared to 27.1% in June 2025

controles.affirmation: EBITDA a 21,6% du CA contre 24,5% ; marge EBITDA ajustee de 25,2% a 24,3% ; 103 M CHF de couts non recurrents
controles.verbatim_source: The EBITDA decreased to CHF 820 million in 2026 from CHF 945 million ... whilst the EBITDA margin was 21.6% in 2026 compared to 24.5% in 2025. In the first half of 2026, Givaudan incurred non-recurring costs of CHF 103 million related to litigation settlements and provisions, restructuring expenses, as well as costs incurred for the competition authorities' investigations into the Fragrance industry. On an adjusted basis, the EBITDA margin decreased to 24.3% in 2026 compared to 25.2% in 2025.

controles.affirmation: Resultat d'exploitation a 635 M CHF contre 762 M CHF, marge de 16,7% contre 19,7%
controles.verbatim_source: The operating income decreased to CHF 635 million in the first half of 2026, compared to CHF 762 million in 2025 ... the operating margin decreased from 19.7% in the first half of 2025 to 16.7% in 2026.

controles.affirmation: Taste & Wellbeing : -6,3% publie, marge d'exploitation 12,7% contre 16,7%, marge EBITDA 18,3% contre 22,0% ; Fragrance & Beauty +2,9% avec une marge d'exploitation de 20,3%
controles.verbatim_source: Taste & Wellbeing sales were CHF 1,789 million, an increase of 0.5% LFL and a decrease of -6.3% in Swiss francs ; the operating income decreased to CHF 228 million in the first half of 2026 from CHF 319 million in 2025. The operating margin decreased to 12.7% in 2026 from 16.7% in 2025 ; the EBITDA margin decreased to 18.3% in 2026 from 22.0% in 2025 ; Fragrance & Beauty sales were CHF 2,010 million, an increase of 6.5% LFL and 2.9% in Swiss francs ; The operating margin was 20.3% in 2026

controles.affirmation: Enquete sectorielle conjointe des autorites europeenne, britannique, americaine, suisse, bresilienne, sud-africaine, indienne et mexicaine ; Givaudan ne peut estimer l'impact financier
controles.verbatim_source: Givaudan is part of an industry-wide investigation by European, UK, US, Swiss, Brazilian, South African, Indian and Mexican competition authorities in relation to certain activities within the Fragrance industry. Givaudan is fully cooperating with the authorities in this respect and as the investigation has not reached any conclusion, Givaudan is not in a position to estimate any financial impact arising therefrom.
controles.correction_proposee: Imprecision mineure a corriger dans le hook uniquement : celui-ci parle de 'huit pays' alors que l'une des huit autorites est europeenne (bloc, pas pays). Le corps de l'ATT dit correctement 'huit juridictions'. Aligner le hook sur 'huit juridictions'.

controles.affirmation: Un accord partiel deja conclu en lien avec cette enquete a contribue aux 103 M CHF de couts non recurrents
controles.verbatim_source: In 2026, litigation settlements and provisions relate to an agreement reached in connection with the broader competition authorities' investigations into the Fragrance industry and a provision recognised due to an adverse judgement against Givaudan in the state of Missouri

controles.affirmation: Litiges diacetyle : provision pour un jugement defavorable isole au Missouri, dossiers ouverts depuis vingt ans, issue non estimable
controles.verbatim_source: Givaudan Flavors Corporation has been named as a defendant in numerous lawsuits ... The plaintiffs allege that they sustained pulmonary injuries due to flavours that contain diacetyl, 2,3 pentanedione and other flavouring ingredients. As of 30 June 2026, the Group has recognised a provision for an adverse isolated judgement against Givaudan in the state of Missouri, United States. Furthermore, many of the numerous other cases filed against the Group's affiliates over the last twenty years have been successfully defended, settled or dismissed. To date, a number of cases remain open and, as with any litigation, the outcomes remain uncertain and the Group is not in a position to estimate any potential outcome arising therefrom.

controles.affirmation: Explosion de Louisville en novembre 2024, deux deces, provisions de 13 M CHF au 30 juin 2026, plusieurs poursuites contre des filiales americaines
controles.verbatim_source: In November 2024 an explosion occurred at the Givaudan Sense Colour facility in Louisville, Kentucky, United States resulting in two fatalities and other injuries to Givaudan employees and causing significant direct and indirect property damage. As of 30 June 2026, the Group has recognised provisions for an amount of CHF 13 million (2025: 13 million). In addition, several lawsuits have been filed against multiple Givaudan US affiliates. Givaudan is not in a position to estimate the full financial impact arising therefrom.

controles.affirmation: Resultat net 475 M CHF contre 592 M CHF (-19,8%), marge nette 12,5% contre 15,3%, BPA ajuste 60,25 CHF contre 66,71 CHF
controles.verbatim_source: The net income for the first six months of 2026 was CHF 475 million compared to CHF 592 million in 2025, resulting in a net profit margin of 12.5% versus 15.3% in 2025. Adjusted basic Earnings per Share were CHF 60.25 versus CHF 66.71 for the same period in 2025.

controles.affirmation: Chiffre d'affaires de 3 799 M CHF au S1 2026, -1,7% publie, +3,6% LFL
controles.verbatim_source: Givaudan Group sales for the first six months of the year were CHF 3,799 million, an increase of 3.6% on a Like-for-Like (LFL) basis and a decrease of -1.7% in Swiss francs, with the continued strength of the Swiss franc impacting the reported sales performance.

controles.affirmation: Gilles Andrier a ete propose comme president du conseil, donc le nouveau CEO Christian Stammkoetter 'se retrouve supervise par son predecesseur direct'
controles.verbatim_source: The Board of Directors will propose Gilles Andrier for election to the role of Chairman ... Furthermore, SHOULD Gilles Andrier BE ELECTED as Chairman, the Board of Directors intends to establish the role of Lead Independent Director ('LID') and appoint Sophie Gasperment as LID. (URD 2025, publie le 30/01/2026) ; 'after a distinguished career of more than 30 years with the Company, including 20 years as CEO, Gilles Andrier will retire on 1 March 2026. He will be succeeded by Christian Stammkoetter.'
controles.correction_proposee: La retraite d'Andrier au 1er mars 2026 et sa PROPOSITION a la presidence sont documentees, mais aucune source du dossier ne confirme son ELECTION effective a l'AG de mars 2026. L'ATT presente comme un fait acquis ('se retrouve donc supervise') une situation que le document formule au conditionnel. Deux corrections : (1) ecrire 'si son election a ete confirmee a l'AG 2026' ou verifier le resultat de l'AG avant publication ; (2) mentionner l'attenuation explicitement prevue par le conseil - la creation d'un poste d'administrateur independant referent (Lead Independent Director) confie a Sophie Gasperment - actuellement omise, ce qui rend l'argument de gouvernance unilateral.
